description: This Swift source file defines a utility namespace 'SimpleTaskSupport' that provides static methods for managing asynchronous tasks, including starting, stopping, and running detached loops with delays.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts an asynchronous task if not already running, executing the provided operation.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops a running task by cancelling it and setting the task reference to nil.

methods.name: startDetachedLoop
methods.description: Starts a detached asynchronous loop that executes the operation repeatedly at specified intervals until cancelled.
